testExecutionNotes: Initial sequential14-tool run had13 passing cases and one fixture-only failed assertion: test Dockerfile contained the test-secret literal that BuildKit correctly echoed. Corrected to compare a hash; the load case passed on focused rerun.
Existing Actions cases were strengthened and rerun5/5; the cancellation case was further aligned with socket-enabled file creation and rerun green.
Exact workdir/stdout assertion exposed Docker-create resource ID contaminating workload stdout. Setup routing was repaired and actual command+environment/missing-image cases rerun green.
Worker proof pauses only its owned supervisor PID at the activation boundary, resumes the same launcher after observing prelaunch state, and gracefully stops all owned roles in Drop.

Worker prelaunch observer gate now obtains the install lock while stopping its owned launcher, then waits for WIFSTOPPED before unlocking; this avoids pausing a launcher while it holds the activation lock. Actual Darwin managed proof validates the gate and will be recorded separately.
